## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Rouen, France. It starts at 105 Bis Allée François Mitterrand.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Dive into a thrilling adventure at Viking City! Immerse yourself in a **360°** journey that stimulates all your senses. Explore immersive rooms that showcase the life of Vikings during the Carolingian Empire.
>
> See Scandinavian customs come to life around you. If you’re in Rouen, don’t miss this unique historical journey!
>
> Viking City welcomes visitors of all ages, from infants to the elderly. The audio is in French, with English subtitles provided.
>
> Spend an unforgettable 1 hour and 15 minutes traveling back in time.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.14. It was rated 4.2 out of 5 from 138 ratings and 69 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
